title: L81 — THE HOURS ALREADY SPENT
_cellule: OITD (Circuit) · Éducation · Risk · regard=les autres traders · présent · −−
voice: Six hours into a position that stopped making sense at hour two.
Rewind. At hour two, the reason you entered was already gone — the level broke, the structure changed.
You didn't stay because the trade improved. You stayed because leaving would waste the six hours.
But the hours are gone either way. They're not in the position — they're behind you, and nothing you do next brings them back.
The only question a position answers is: would I open this now, at this price? Follow @kongrave_ — the mechanics nobody explains.

on teste les deux issues : fermer maintenant → les six heures restent derrière. Tenir encore → les six heures restent derrière AUSSI, et une septième s'ajoute. Aucune décision ne les récupère. Elles ne sont pas un actif de la position, elles sont un fait du passé.

caption:
Six hours into a position that stopped making sense at hour two — and the hours are the only thing still holding it open.

The level broke early, the structure changed, and the reason to be there died long before the position did. What kept it alive wasn't the chart, it was the weight of what had already been spent. But those hours sit behind you either way: closing now doesn't waste them, and holding doesn't recover them.

Follow @kongrave_ — the mechanics nobody explains.
